image-tools.editor-host.image-editor.note: Title of the full-screen drawing editor for SVG images. A noun phrase.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.ask-an-admin.text: Ask an administrator to add one.
image-tools.mc-image-picker.ask-an-admin.note: Hint in the image picker's empty state, for users without admin rights. Follows No images yet.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.cancel.note: Button that closes the image picker without choosing an image. A verb.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.draw-a-new-i.note: Button in the image picker window that opens the drawing editor. Same English as the button in the image field, which is outside the picker.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.images.note: Title of the image picker window. Plural noun.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.images-need-.text: Images need Magic Card Utils. It is installed through HACS, like Magic Card.
image-tools.mc-image-picker.images-need-.note: Message inside the image picker window when the companion integration is missing. HACS is a Home Assistant add-on store; keep the name. Magic Card and Magic Card Utils are product names.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.in-use.note: Badge on an image in the picker that a card already uses.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.loading-imag.note: Shown in the image picker while the image list is being fetched.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.n.text: {n, plural, one {# live connection} other {# live connections}}
image-tools.mc-image-picker.n.note: Short label on an image thumbnail. {n} is how many live connections the image has. A live connection links a part of the image to a Home Assistant entity so it changes with it. Compare the longer version with Live: in front.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.n-2.note: Accessible name of the same live connection count, with Live as a prefix. {n} is the number of connections.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.n-kib.note: File size of an image. {n} is a number of kibibytes (1,024 bytes). Keep the unit KiB.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.no-image-mat.note: Empty search result in the image picker. {query} is the text the user typed in the search field.

vars.query: The value that replaces query in the text.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.no-images-ye.note: Empty state of the image picker when the library holds no images.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.pick-an-imag.note: Accessible name of the list of images in the picker window. Compare Choose an image in the image field.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.search-image.note: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field in the image picker. Search is a verb.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.the-images-c.text: The images could not be loaded.
image-tools.mc-image-picker.the-images-c.note: Error in the image picker when the library list could not be fetched. Followed by a Try again button.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.thumbnails-s.text: Thumbnails show the saved colours. On the card the live parts change with their devices.
image-tools.mc-image-picker.thumbnails-s.note: Help text in the image picker. Live parts are the parts of an image connected to Home Assistant entities, so their colours change with the device state.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.try-again.note: Button that retries loading the image list after an error. A verb phrase.

image-tools.mc-image-picker.use-this-ima.note: Button in the image picker that confirms the selected image for the card. A verb.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.accen.note: Label of a colour picker for the second of the two colours of an image. Pairs with Main colour.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.add-a.text: Add an image module behind the content
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.add-a.note: Button that adds an image element to the card, placed behind everything else as a background. A module is one element of the card.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.addre.note: Label of the choice to use a web address (URL) or a file from the Home Assistant media browser instead of a library image.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.adds-.text: Adds a hidden list after the picture, for example "Kitchen light: on". It updates when a device changes.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.adds-.note: Help text of the switch that adds a list of device states for screen readers. The example Kitchen light: on shows the pattern device name, colon, state; translate it naturally.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.and-n.note: End of a shortened list of devices. {n} is how many further devices are not shown.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.card-.note: Screen reader announcement after picking an image. {shape} is the card's new aspect ratio, such as 4/3 or 1.

vars.shape: The value that replaces shape in the text.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.choos.note: Short button that opens the image picker when no image is set. A verb. Compare Pick another, which replaces an image.
Accessible name of the Choose button. Compare Pick an image, which names the list inside the picker window.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.clear.note: Button that removes the chosen image from the field. A verb.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.colou.note: Accessible name of the group with the Main colour and Accent colour pickers. Plural noun.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.copy-.note: Button that copies the image's reference (its address in the library) to the clipboard. A verb.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.descr.note: Label of a text area for alternative text that describes the image to people who cannot see it.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.draw-.note: Button in the image field that opens the drawing editor. Same English as the button inside the picker window.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.edit-.note: Button that opens the chosen image in the drawing editor. A verb. Not the same as View image.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.hide-.note: Button that collapses the list of devices that are connected to the image. Opposite of Show list.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.id-no.note: Shown when the image's reference points to a library image that no longer exists. {id} is the image's reference, a technical identifier. Keep it as is.

vars.id: The value that replaces id in the text.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.image.note: Label of the image field, and name of the image module type. A noun.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.image.text: Image module added behind the content. Remove the background layer if you no longer need it.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.image.note: Confirmation after the background image was added. A module is one element of the card. A layer is an element stacked behind others.
Screen reader announcement after the user picked an image. {name} is the image's name. Set is a past participle: the image was set, not a set of images.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.image.text: Images need Magic Card Utils. It is installed through HACS, like Magic Card.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.image.note: Message in the image field when the companion integration is missing. Same English as the message inside the picker window. HACS is a Home Assistant add-on store; keep the name.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.libra.note: Label of the choice to use an image from the shared image library. Opposite of Address or media.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.list-.text: List connected devices and their states for screen readers
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.list-.note: Label of a switch. List is a verb: write out the devices and their current states as hidden text for screen readers.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.live.note: Badge on an image that has live connections, meaning parts of it follow Home Assistant devices. An adjective.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.live-.text: Live: parts of this picture follow their devices, here too.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.live-.note: Tooltip that explains the Live badge. Starts with the badge name, which should match the translation of Live. Here too means in the editor as well as on the card.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.main-.text: Main and Accent follow the colours you set for this card.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.main-.note: Help text for the two colour pickers. Main and Accent are the labels Main colour and Accent colour; keep them consistent.
Label of a colour picker for the first of the two colours of an image. Pairs with Accent colour.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.n.note: Short summary of an image. {n} is how many devices (Home Assistant entities) the image follows.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.n-lef.note: Character counter under the description box. {n} is how many more characters can be typed before the limit.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.need-.note: Question that introduces the button for adding a separate image module. It is shown above the Add an image module behind the content button.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.no-im.note: Shown in the image field when no image is set.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.not-f.note: Placed after a device's technical name in the list when Home Assistant no longer knows that device. The brackets are part of the text.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.not-s.text: Not set (screen readers skip this picture)
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.not-s.note: Status under the description box when the description is empty. Opposite of Set (screen readers read it).

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.off.note: State of the switch that lists connected devices. Opposite of On.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.on.note: State of the switch that lists connected devices. Opposite of Off.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.optio.text: Optional. Describe what the picture shows. Without it, screen readers skip the picture.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.optio.note: Help text under the description box. Describe is an instruction to the user.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.pick-.note: Button that opens the image picker to replace the chosen image. Compare Choose, which is shown when no image is set.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.refer.note: Confirmation after Copy reference. A reference is the image's address in the library.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.renam.text: Rename a device in Home Assistant to change what is read.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.renam.note: Help text under the list of devices that screen readers will read out. Read means spoken aloud by the screen reader.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.set-s.note: Status under the description box when a description is filled in. Set means filled in. Opposite of Not set (screen readers skip this picture).

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.show-.note: Button that expands the list of devices that are connected to the image. Opposite of Hide list.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.that-.text: That is the longest description (500 characters).
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.that-.note: Warning when the description reached its maximum length of 500 characters. The number is fixed text.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.the-c.text: The card shape ({card}) differs from the drawing ({drawing}).
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.the-c.note: Warning. {card} is the card's current aspect ratio, such as 16/9. {drawing} is the shape of the image, such as 4/3 or Square. Followed by a button to match them.

vars.card: The value that replaces card in the text.
vars.drawing: The value that replaces drawing in the text.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.the-d.text: The drawing editor could not load. Try again.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.the-d.note: Error when the drawing editor failed to load, usually a network problem.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.the-r.text: The reference could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.the-r.note: Error when copying to the clipboard failed. The reference is the image's address shown in the field above.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.this-.text: This image is no longer in the library.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.this-.note: Warning when the chosen image has been deleted from the library.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.this-.text: This is a background. Screen readers skip it, and it cannot hold buttons.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.this-.note: Help text shown when the image sits behind the card's content. Background means purely decorative.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.this-.text: This is the address cards use. It stays the same when you rename the image.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.this-.note: Help text under the image's reference. The address is a technical identifier, not a web address.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.this-.text: This picture shows live devices. Add a description or switch on the list so everyone can follow it.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.this-.note: Accessibility hint. Live devices are Home Assistant entities the picture follows. The list is the Show list switch for screen readers.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.to-ch.text: To change colours, use live parts in one picture. To swap pictures, use states.
image-tools.mc-library-image-field.to-ch.note: Tip. Live parts are parts of an image connected to Home Assistant entities. States are the card's feature to show a different picture per entity state.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.use-t.note: Button that sets the card's aspect ratio to match the drawing. Follows a warning that the two differ.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.view-.note: Button that opens the chosen image for viewing only, without editing. A verb. Not the same as Edit image.

image-tools.mc-library-image-field.will-.note: Introduces the list of devices and states a screen reader will announce. Read means spoken aloud. A colon follows and the list comes after it.
